summary: Corporacion America Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 results. The release details revenues excluding IFRIC12 of $470.7 million, up 8.2% year-over-year, and adjusted EBITDA excluding IFRIC12 of $160.3 million, down 4.5%. The company reported cash and equivalents of $692.5 million and net debt to LTM adjusted EBITDA of 0.5x. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, containing no M&A activity, strategic review, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any corporate action.
